moments.title: Boardmasters Festival LIVE
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest surf and music festival, Boardmasters, is in full swing on the Cornish coast, running until Sunday with a huge lineup of artists across multiple stages.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Sun, surf, and serious tunes! Boardmasters is bringing the summer vibes to Cornwall right now. Who's there?

angles.name: Artist Spotlight
angles.copy: From Fatboy Slim to The Kooks, the Boardmasters lineup this weekend is stacked! What act are you most excited for?

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Cornwall is buzzing! Boardmasters is taking over Newquay with incredible music and surf action all weekend. Are you heading down?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham on Monday, August 10th, marking the first time a British city has hosted the prestigious event, with stars like Jakob Ingebrigtsen and Keely Hodgkinson set to compete.

angles.name: Countdown to Gold
angles.copy: Just 3 days until the European Athletics Championships hit Birmingham! Who are you backing for glory at Alexander Stadium?

angles.name: Home Soil History
angles.copy: History in the making! Birmingham hosts the European Athletics Championships for the very first time starting Monday. Get ready for a week of world-class action.

angles.name: Stars to Watch
angles.copy: All eyes on Birmingham next week! Jakob Ingebrigtsen, Keely Hodgkinson and Mondo Duplantis are just some of the big names competing at the European Athletics Championships.

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival LIVE
moments.blurb: The world-renowned Edinburgh Fringe Festival is underway, transforming Scotland's capital into a hub of comedy, theatre, music, and arts until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe is ON
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the sound of laughter, music, and drama! The Fringe Festival is officially open, bringing incredible talent to Scotland's capital.

angles.name: What to See
angles.copy: Comedy, theatre, dance, music – if it's happening, it's at the Edinburgh Fringe! What's on your must-see list this year?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Season Kick-off
angles.copy: The football season officially kicks off next week! Arsenal take on Man City in the Community Shield at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on August 16th.

angles.name: Welsh Football Host
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the FA Community Shield next Sunday! Get ready for a huge clash between Arsenal and Manchester City at Principality Stadium.

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's legendary frontman, Bruce Dickinson, celebrates his 68th birthday today, August 7th.

angles.name: Metal Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson! The Iron Maiden legend is still rocking stages worldwide. What's your favourite Maiden track?

moments.title: The Edge's 65th Birthday
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge, born David Howell Evans, turns 65 tomorrow, August 8th.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge, celebrates his 65th birthday! That distinctive sound is unmistakable. What's your favourite U2 song?

moments.title: Joe Jackson's 72nd Birthday
moments.blurb: British new wave and jazz-pop artist Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! On Sunday, Joe Jackson turns 72. Which of his classic tracks gets you 'Steppin' Out'?

moments.title: Mark Knopfler's 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and guitar maestro Mark Knopfler, known for his unique fingerstyle playing, celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler this Monday! The Dire Straits legend's guitar work is pure magic. What's your top Dire Straits tune?

moments.title: Danny Jones's 40th Birthday
moments.blurb: McFly guitarist and vocalist Danny Jones, a familiar face from the pop scene and TV, turns 40 on August 13th.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Icon
angles.copy: Can you believe it? McFly's Danny Jones hits the big 4-0 on Tuesday! Wish him a happy birthday by playing your favourite McFly hit!
